title.zh: Jev：面向自动化的System One模型

excerpt.zh: Jev是TypeSafe AI推出的System One模型，面向软件自动化提供快速、类型安全且带置信度的结构化决策，但长期可靠性仍待验证。
excerpt.en: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model for fast, typed decisions in software automation, though long-term reliability remains unproven.

text.zh: Jev：为软件自动化设计的决策模型
text.en: Jev: A Decision Model for Software Automation

text.zh: Jev是TypeSafe AI发布的首个System One模型，目标不是生成聊天文本，而是把非结构化状态转换为软件可以直接使用的类型化概率决策。公司创始人表示，这一方向源于现有聊天模型难以稳定驱动自动化的问题。
text.en: Jev is TypeSafe AI's first System One model. Instead of generating conversational text, it turns unstructured state into typed, probabilistic decisions that software can use directly. The company says the approach addresses the difficulty of using chat-oriented models for dependable automation.

text.zh: System One模型强调速度与结构
text.en: System One Models Prioritize Speed and Structure

text.zh: TypeSafe称，Jev采用新模型架构、并行采样器和“校准决策强化学习”（RLCD），一次查询并行产生输出，并附带置信度。其早期数据宣称端到端延迟为70至500毫秒；模型放弃自由文本生成，以换取固定结构、无类型错误和更易嵌入工作流的接口。
text.en: TypeSafe says Jev combines a new architecture, parallel sampling, and Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD). It produces outputs in parallel and includes confidence estimates. The company reports 70–500 ms end-to-end latency in early results, trading open-ended text generation for fixed schemas and workflow-friendly interfaces.

text.zh: Jev的评测证据仍需外部检验
text.en: Jev's Evidence Still Needs Independent Testing

text.zh: 这些结论目前主要来自TypeSafe的演示和工作流评测，部分输入经过简化，且测试由其能力团队设计；参考模型、包装方式和数据来源也可能影响比较结果。Jev目前处于早期访问阶段，定价可持续性尚未证明，长期真实业务中的准确率、校准置信度和泛化能力仍是关键问题。
text.en: The evidence currently comes mainly from TypeSafe demos and workflow evaluations. Some inputs were simplified, the workflows were created by its capabilities team, and the reference models and wrappers may affect comparisons. Jev is in early access; pricing sustainability is unproven, and real-world accuracy, calibration, and generalization remain open questions.
